data.title: 战栗的龙卷 · 冬夜窗边的城市
data.description: 高层公寓窗边，她盘腿悬浮在玻璃前看夜景，手里捧着热可可；城市的灯火映在绿瞳里——守护这座城市的理由，她从来不说。
data.action: 高层公寓窗边，她盘腿悬浮在玻璃前看夜景，手里捧着热可可
data.promptProse: Tatsumaki floats cross-legged beside her high-rise window, holding hot cocoa in both hands and quietly watching the city she protects. Her cream turtleneck and loose green trousers stay comfortable beneath curled green hair. The horizontal medium portrait includes the window frame and far lights below. Room lamplight warms the cup and sweater texture, while city reflections appear in her green eyes and across the glass behind her suspended outline.
